# `aitbc node bridge approve`

Approve a bridge request from another island.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node bridge approve [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |
| `--approving-node-id` | text | — | yes | The Approving node id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node bridge approve --request-id <request_id> --approving-node-id <approving_node_id>
```
